judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and fulfills all acceptance criteria, including adding comprehensive tests for multi-round accumulation and missing round usage. To make the hook's signature unambiguous, the candidate introduced a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` whereas the reference renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` (which also caused the doc-block sync in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md` to differ, and if `TotalUsageMetadata` isn't re-exported at the package root, consumers inspecting the hook type may see an unexported alias). Additionally, the candidate created a separate acceptance test file and left a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff rather than keeping all tests inside `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and moving the spec assertion out of the 'out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`.
